name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – § 4 – Am 113
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 4. Regrets the sharp increase in the financing and liquidity-management costs of NGEU; reiterates its opposition to common Union borrowing and to the establishment of a permanent debt or fiscal capacity at Union level; insists that only legally binding debt-service expenditure actually falling due in 2027 be financed within the existing MFF ceilings through savings and redeployment from non-essential expenditure, without new Union taxes, additional national contributions, recourse to special instruments or further common borrowing; calls on the Commission to provide complete, timely and auditable information on borrowing, disbursements, interest expenditure, liquidity-management costs and the Union’s total contingent liabilities;
